summary.text: Justin McIsaac is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Strafford 19, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as an award-winning freelance sports broadcaster and lifelong New Hampshire resident.

paragraphs.text: McIsaac's Ballotpedia profile lists his profession as broadcaster.
In the survey, he listed three campaign messages: public money for public schools, banning AI data centers, and lower property taxes.
He said he is passionate about reversing what he called the eradication of public education in New Hampshire.
